$description: The colour pairs every scheme of every palette must pass, or the token build stops (CHU-T060). The build reads them (scripts/tokens.mjs), and so do the docs, which show each with its reason. {intent} is each of the intents in turn; {Intent} is its name capitalised. Each pair's background maps to its label.

pairs.why: Body text, on the page and on everything that sits on it.

bg.surface.raised: Muted text on a raised surface
bg.surface.sunken: Muted text on a sunken well

pairs.why: Secondary text is still text: quieter, never under AA.
An intent as text: links and the caret (accent), status words, a field's error.
Labels and icons on a candy, and on its light band, which is the whole fill of a soft box.
A visited link changes colour, and still reads.
The outline of a field or an outline button shows where to click: non-text contrast, WCAG 1.4.11.
Text the reader selects stays readable on the selection colour.
Text on an inverted surface, which is the scheme's text colour.
Disabled is dithered, never greyed: the label still reads on the checkerboard over the candy.

bg.disabled.dither: Ink label on a disabled candy

pairs.why: Plain candies label in ink: on their dither, and on cream's own, lighter one.
